sloka: ततो नगेन्द्र संकाशैः तीक्ष्ण दन्ष्ट्रैः महाबलैः ।कृत्स्ना संछादिता भूमिः असंख्येयैः प्लवंगमैः ॥४-३९-१०॥
transliteration: tato nagendra saṁkāśaiḥ tīkṣṇa danṣṭraiḥ mahābalaiḥ ।kṛtsnā saṁchāditā bhūmiḥ asaṁkhyeyaiḥ plavaṁgamaiḥ ॥4-39-10॥

translations.english: In a minute, the entire land was crowded with innumerable powerful monkeys of the size of mountains having sharp fangs.The monkey leaders with a hundred crore monkey followers, who could assume any form at their will mighty monkeys from the mountains, rivers and seas vanaras thundering like clouds and other free vanaras who were wanderers vanaras red in colour like the rising Sun, tawny coloured ones like the Moon some who were of the hue of white lotus filaments and some vanaras residing in mount Meru came there.
translations.hindi: देखते देखते पहाड़ जेसे विशाल शरीरधारी, पेने पेने दांता वाले और महाबली अगणित वानरों से सारी प्रथिवी ढक जाडे
